sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
;Separate missions
[[File:S2E41 Dante 5.png|thumb|[[Dante Vale]] exploring the [[Sea of Cortés]]]]
[[Dante Vale]] decided to split the team: while he navigates the stormy [[Sea of Cortés]] alone, he sent [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Den Fears]] to the city of [[Hamelin, Germany|Hamelin]] in Germany for a purpose they don't know. There, the trio meets with [[Guggenheim]], who gives them the task to investigate mysterious perturbations happening at the local cathedral and report back on their findings.

;Infinite infestation
At sunset, Lok, Sophie and Den start exploring the cathedral. It is completely silent, until Lok sees scattered candles. The trio walks toward a stained glass which depicts the legend of Hamelin and contains what seems to be an amulet, and Sophie recounts the legend of the [[Pied Piper]]. Lok then notices a chalice bouncing off a table and steps closer, but gets startled by the sudden appearance of a small rat-like Titan, called [[Gremlow]]. The [[Holotome]] says these Titans move in swarms but Lok, seemingly confident, tries to gain the lonely rat's sympathy. Sophie and Den suddenly start yell to warn him: al swarm of Gremlows is now running down the walls of the cathedral to attack them. 
[[File:S2E41 Den Gremlow Augerfrost.png|thumb|Den fighting the [[Gremlow|Gremlows]]]]
They use a variety of spells to eliminate the Gremlows, but quickly notice that they resurrect and even multiply. The rats end up swarming the whole cathedral and swallowing up Sophie. Lok and Den invoke [[Dendras]] and [[Cursed Archer]] to free her, but the team realizes that no matter how hard they fight, the rats keep on reapparing. Sophie glances at the stained glass and understands that they need the song from the legend of the Pied Piper to eliminate the Gremlows. Completely overwhelmed, the team runs out of the cathedral as fast as possible, and Sophie uses [[Stopglue]] to temporarily seal the doors.

;Shopping for a flute
A flashback shows a pre-recorded message from [[Eathon Lambert]], telling Lok to follow one of [[Quatrains of Nostradamus|Nostradamus' quatrains]] in order to find one of the [[Legendary Titans]]. The quatrain talks about a "child's song" to be used in the waters of the Conqueror to the West. The team realizes the reason why Dante went exploring the Sea of Cortés, and Sophie also seems to understand why he sent them to this town. She asks Guggenheim where they can find a flute, but [[Cherit]] suddenly arrives and warns them that the doors of the cathedral are about to break open. Lok and Den are off to contain the Gremlows while Sophie and Guggenheim go find a flute. 

In the Sea of Cortés, Dante parks his boat and dives in the sea. He stumbles upon a threatening giant [[squid]] but scares him off with [[Metagolem]]. The Titan also opens up a passage to an underwater cave and Dante realizes he's on the right track. Meanwhile, Sophie and Guggenheim walk through the market of Hamelin and Sophie finally finds a shop that sells instruments. She buys a flute while Guggenheim, distracted by the smell of flowers, left her alone. 

Sophie is followed by two [[Suits]] as she walks away from the shop. They end up cornering her in an alley and she invokes [[Sabriel]], but the Suits overwhelm her with [[Shadow Agent]], [[Doom Warden]] and their spells. In the cathedral, Lok and Den manage to wipe out the entire army of Gremlows.  Guggenheim arrives, telling them about how he lost track of Sophie in the market. In the Sea of Cortés, Dante enters the underwater crypt and discovers a Titan as well as an unbreakable force field that have been left there to guard [[Hernán Cortés]]' treasure. Dante understands that, just like the quatrain says, they need a child's song to break the defenses.

;A new Pied Piper
Sophie is in bad posture but Den suddenly arrives with Cherit to save her, and together with Sabriel and [[Vigilante]], they defeat the Suits. Meanwhile in the cathedral, Lok and Guggenheim struggle to contain the everlasting Gremlows. Guggenheim showcases his powers and uses his [[Bulreguard]] to wipe off a large portion of them, but they end up reapparing again.
[[File:S2E41 Sophie Gremlow.png|thumb|Sophie controlling the [[Gremlow|Gremlows]]]]
Suddenly, they both hear a melody as Sophie walks in the cathedral while playing the flute. The Gremlows' attitude immediately changes and they start placing themselves behind Sophie. Lok tells her to walk them up to the stained glass, and that effectively leads all the Gremlows to jump back inside their amulet.

After they are all gone, a ray of magic transforms Sophie's flute into the original flute of the Pied Piper. The team goes back to Italy and have a call with Dante who is still abroad. Sophie explains that the notes of the melody were written on the stained glass. Dante tells the team that the flute will be of use again, and invites them to join him in California.

Separate missions

Image caption: Dante Vale exploring the Sea of Cortés

Infinite infestation

Lok then notices a chalice bouncing off a table and steps closer, but gets startled by the sudden appearance of a small rat-like Titan, called Gremlow. The Holotome says these Titans move in swarms but Lok, seemingly confident, tries to gain the lonely rat's sympathy. Sophie and Den suddenly start yell to warn him: al swarm of Gremlows is now running down the walls of the cathedral to attack them.

Image caption: Den fighting the Gremlows

They use a variety of spells to eliminate the Gremlows, but quickly notice that they resurrect and even multiply. The rats end up swarming the whole cathedral and swallowing up Sophie. Lok and Den invoke Dendras and Cursed Archer to free her, but the team realizes that no matter how hard they fight, the rats keep on reapparing. Sophie glances at the stained glass and understands that they need the song from the legend of the Pied Piper to eliminate the Gremlows. Completely overwhelmed, the team runs out of the cathedral as fast as possible, and Sophie uses Stopglue to temporarily seal the doors.

Shopping for a flute
A flashback shows a pre-recorded message from Eathon Lambert, telling Lok to follow one of Nostradamus' quatrains in order to find one of the Legendary Titans. The quatrain talks about a "child's song" to be used in the waters of the Conqueror to the West. The team realizes the reason why Dante went exploring the Sea of Cortés, and Sophie also seems to understand why he sent them to this town. She asks Guggenheim where they can find a flute, but Cherit suddenly arrives and warns them that the doors of the cathedral are about to break open. In the Sea of Cortés, Dante parks his boat and dives in the sea. He stumbles upon a threatening giant squid but scares him off with Metagolem. The Titan also opens up a passage to an underwater cave and Dante realizes he's on the right track. Meanwhile, Sophie and Guggenheim walk through the market of Hamelin and Sophie finally finds a shop that sells instruments. She buys a flute while Guggenheim, distracted by the smell of flowers, left her alone.

Sophie is followed by two Suits as she walks away from the shop. They end up cornering her in an alley and she invokes Sabriel, but the Suits overwhelm her with Shadow Agent, Doom Warden and their spells. Dante understands that, just like the quatrain says, they need a child's song to break the defenses.

A new Pied Piper
Sophie is in bad posture but Den suddenly arrives with Cherit to save her, and together with Sabriel and Vigilante, they defeat the Suits. Meanwhile in the cathedral, Lok and Guggenheim struggle to contain the everlasting Gremlows. Guggenheim showcases his powers and uses his Bulreguard to wipe off a large portion of them, but they end up reapparing again.

Image caption: Sophie controlling the Gremlows

Suddenly, they both hear a melody as Sophie walks in the cathedral while playing the flute. The Gremlows' attitude immediately changes and they start placing themselves behind Sophie. Lok tells her to walk them up to the stained glass, and that effectively leads all the Gremlows to jump back inside their amulet.

After they are all gone, a ray of magic transforms Sophie's flute into the original flute of the Pied Piper. The team goes back to Italy and have a call with Dante who is still abroad. sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* When the legend of the [[Wikipedia:Pied Piper of Hamelin|Pied Piper]] is mentioned, the resolution of the episode can be predicted quite easily.
* The flower that distracts [[Guggenheim]] at the market is [[wikipedia:Centaurea cyanus|''Centaurea cyanus'']].
* In the dubs where Powerbonded Titans are voiced, [[Unnamed Suit 057|Suit 057]] is surprised by the fact that [[Sabriel]] answered Sophie's order to cast [[Sorcerel#Powerbonding|Truth Shield]]. In the dubs where Powerbonded Titans are mute, Suit 057 is just surprised by the ability Truth Shield itself, and the dialogue is quite different.

sections.heading: Production Errors
sections.wikitext:
*Gremlow is misidentified as a [[Yama-Titan]] by the [[Holotome]], contradicting with Gremlow's multiple [[Litho-Titan]] traits: his stone-like armor and physiology, purple energy essence, Litho-Titan amulet coloration, and geographical and mythological ties to Europe. Moreover, Gremlow is listed as a Litho-Titan on the show's official artist reference sheets, therefore the line is confirmed to be a scripting error.
*When Sophie summons [[Sabriel|Powerbonded Sabriel]], her non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.
*The city of [[Hamelin, Germany]], was misspelled as ''Hamlin''.
sections.text:

Moreover, Gremlow is listed as a Litho-Titan on the show's official artist reference sheets, therefore the line is confirmed to be a scripting error.
• When Sophie summons Powerbonded Sabriel, her non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.
• The city of Hamelin, Germany, was misspelled as Hamlin.

full_text:
The meeting of the Casterwill elders is disrupted when Kiel and his Spiral army attack. The Huntik team fights alongside the Casterwills, and Sophie faces Kiel. Bonding with Powerbonded Sorcerel, Sophie barely wins, leaving Lok to save her from a rampaging Efreet King. After the battle, Sophie finally wins the leadership of the Casterwills.

[[Dante Vale]] decided to split the team: while he navigates the stormy [[Sea of Cortés]] alone, he sent [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Den Fears]] to the city of [[Hamelin, Germany|Hamelin]] in Germany for a purpose they don't know. There, the trio meets with [[Guggenheim]], who gives them the task to investigate mysterious perturbations happening at the local cathedral and report back on their findings.

;Infinite infestation
At sunset, Lok, Sophie and Den start exploring the cathedral. It is completely silent, until Lok sees scattered candles. The trio walks toward a stained glass which depicts the legend of Hamelin and contains what seems to be an amulet, and Sophie recounts the legend of the [[Pied Piper]]. Lok then notices a chalice bouncing off a table and steps closer, but gets startled by the sudden appearance of a small rat-like Titan, called [[Gremlow]]. The [[Holotome]] says these Titans move in swarms but Lok, seemingly confident, tries to gain the lonely rat's sympathy. Sophie and Den suddenly start yell to warn him: al swarm of Gremlows is now running down the walls of the cathedral to attack them. 
[[File:S2E41 Den Gremlow Augerfrost.png|thumb|Den fighting the [[Gremlow|Gremlows]]]]
They use a variety of spells to eliminate the Gremlows, but quickly notice that they resurrect and even multiply. The rats end up swarming the whole cathedral and swallowing up Sophie. Lok and Den invoke [[Dendras]] and [[Cursed Archer]] to free her, but the team realizes that no matter how hard they fight, the rats keep on reapparing. Sophie glances at the stained glass and understands that they need the song from the legend of the Pied Piper to eliminate the Gremlows. Completely overwhelmed, the team runs out of the cathedral as fast as possible, and Sophie uses [[Stopglue]] to temporarily seal the doors.

;Shopping for a flute
A flashback shows a pre-recorded message from [[Eathon Lambert]], telling Lok to follow one of [[Quatrains of Nostradamus|Nostradamus' quatrains]] in order to find one of the [[Legendary Titans]]. The quatrain talks about a "child's song" to be used in the waters of the Conqueror to the West. The team realizes the reason why Dante went exploring the Sea of Cortés, and Sophie also seems to understand why he sent them to this town. She asks Guggenheim where they can find a flute, but [[Cherit]] suddenly arrives and warns them that the doors of the cathedral are about to break open. Lok and Den are off to contain the Gremlows while Sophie and Guggenheim go find a flute. 

In the Sea of Cortés, Dante parks his boat and dives in the sea. He stumbles upon a threatening giant [[squid]] but scares him off with [[Metagolem]]. The Titan also opens up a passage to an underwater cave and Dante realizes he's on the right track. Meanwhile, Sophie and Guggenheim walk through the market of Hamelin and Sophie finally finds a shop that sells instruments. She buys a flute while Guggenheim, distracted by the smell of flowers, left her alone. 

Sophie is followed by two [[Suits]] as she walks away from the shop. They end up cornering her in an alley and she invokes [[Sabriel]], but the Suits overwhelm her with [[Shadow Agent]], [[Doom Warden]] and their spells. In the cathedral, Lok and Den manage to wipe out the entire army of Gremlows.  Guggenheim arrives, telling them about how he lost track of Sophie in the market. In the Sea of Cortés, Dante enters the underwater crypt and discovers a Titan as well as an unbreakable force field that have been left there to guard [[Hernán Cortés]]' treasure. Dante understands that, just like the quatrain says, they need a child's song to break the defenses.

;A new Pied Piper
Sophie is in bad posture but Den suddenly arrives with Cherit to save her, and together with Sabriel and [[Vigilante]], they defeat the Suits. Meanwhile in the cathedral, Lok and Guggenheim struggle to contain the everlasting Gremlows. Guggenheim showcases his powers and uses his [[Bulreguard]] to wipe off a large portion of them, but they end up reapparing again.
[[File:S2E41 Sophie Gremlow.png|thumb|Sophie controlling the [[Gremlow|Gremlows]]]]
Suddenly, they both hear a melody as Sophie walks in the cathedral while playing the flute. The Gremlows' attitude immediately changes and they start placing themselves behind Sophie. Lok tells her to walk them up to the stained glass, and that effectively leads all the Gremlows to jump back inside their amulet.

After they are all gone, a ray of magic transforms Sophie's flute into the original flute of the Pied Piper. The team goes back to Italy and have a call with Dante who is still abroad. Sophie explains that the notes of the melody were written on the stained glass. Dante tells the team that the flute will be of use again, and invites them to join him in California.
